posts.headline: #FreeMaxx Champions💍 have the ring, but their own history says the encore is a disaster waiting to happen.
posts.detail: Tyrique14 won it all in 2025, yet a career average finish of 5.5 and a worst finish of 8 across just two seasons screams one-hit wonder. Rings mean nothing on draft night — prove it wasn't a fluke.

posts.headline: Put it in Ra is the best team in Busters Anonymous history to NEVER win the whole thing, and that's a problem.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career record, a .714 win pct, and an average finish of 1.5 is video-game numbers — but zero titles in two seasons means adambarner111 is officially this league's Buffalo Bills. Time to stop choking at the finish line.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh finished dead last in their only season and nobody should expect anything different in 2026.
posts.detail: A 4-10 record and a 12th-place finish out of 12 teams isn't bad luck, it's a pattern. Until they show otherwise, this roster is a preseason punchline.

posts.headline: Sasinci's World has a title in the trophy case but plays like a team that's forgotten how to win.
posts.detail: Alxgalvn's squad owns a championship yet sports a losing 13-15 career record and a worst finish of 8 — that's not contender behavior, that's a fluke wearing a crown. The league isn't scared, and it should be worried why not.

posts.headline: SwooshAnoosh is the freshest bottom-feeder in the league and draft season hasn't even humbled them yet.
posts.detail: A rookie campaign that ended 5-9 with an 11th-place finish out of 12 is about as inauspicious a debut as it gets. Until SwooshAnoosh proves otherwise, they're penciled in for another year in the cellar.
